sentences.en: ANGELA: Hello, Flanders conference hotel
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 您好，弗兰德斯会议酒店。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, hi
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: I wanted to ask about conference facilities at the hotel
sentences.zh: 我想咨询一下贵酒店的会议设施情况。

sentences.en: Have come through to the right person?
sentences.zh: 我找对人了吗？

sentences.en: ANGELA: You have
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 没错，您找对人了。

sentences.en: I'm the customer services manager
sentences.zh: 我是客户服务经理。

sentences.en: My name's Angela
sentences.zh: 我叫安吉拉。

sentences.en: So how can I Example help you?
sentences.zh: 那么，我能如何帮您呢？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, I'm calling from Barrett and Stansons, we're a medical company based in Perth
sentences.zh: MAN: 呃，我来自巴雷特与斯坦森公司，我们是一家总部位于珀斯的医疗公司。

sentences.en: ANGELA: Oh yes
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: MAN: And we're organising a conference for our clients to be held in Sydney
sentences.zh: MAN: 我们正为我们的客户在悉尼举办一场会议。

sentences.en: It'll be held over two days and we're expecting about fifty or sixty people
sentences.zh: 会议为期两天，预计参会人数约五十至六十人。

sentences.en: ANGELA: When were you thinking of having it?
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 您打算把会议安排在什么时候呢？

sentences.en: MAN: Some time early next year, like the end of January?
sentences.zh: MAN: 明年初的某个时间，比如一月底？

sentences.en: It'd have to be a weekend
sentences.zh: 必须安排在周末。

sentences.en: ANGELA: Let me see ... our conference facilities are already booked for the weekend beginning January 28th
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 让我查一下……1月28日那个周末的会议设施已经全部预订满了。

sentences.en: We could do the first weekend in February?
sentences.zh: 二月的第一个周末可以吗？

sentences.en: MAN: How about January 21st?
sentences.zh: MAN: 1月21日怎么样？

sentences.en: ANGELA: I'm afraid that's booked too
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 很抱歉，那天也已预订满了。

sentences.en: MAN: Well. let's go for the February date then
sentences.zh: MAN: 那好吧，我们就定二月的日期吧。

sentences.en: ANGELA: So that's the weekend beginning the 4th
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 所以就是从2月4日开始的那个周末。

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Now can you tell me a bit about what conference facilities you have?
sentences.zh: 现在您能向我介绍一下贵方需要哪些会议设施吗？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Sure
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So for talks and presentations we have the Tesla room
sentences.zh: 用于演讲和演示的是特斯拉会议室。

sentences.en: MAN: Sorry?
sentences.zh: MAN: 抱歉，您能再说一遍吗？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Tesla that's spelled 1T-E-S-L-A
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 特斯拉，拼写是T-E-S-L-A。

sentences.en: It holds up to a hundred people, and it's fully equipped with a projector and so on
sentences.zh: 该会议室最多可容纳一百人，并配备投影仪等全套设备。

sentences.en: MAN: How about a microphone?
sentences.zh: MAN: 有麦克风吗？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Yes, that'll be all set up ready for you, and there'll be one that members of the audience can use too, for questions, if necessary
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 有的，我们会为您提前安装调试好；另外，现场还会另备一支供听众提问时使用的麦克风（如有需要）。

sentences.en: MAN: Fine
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And we'll also need some sort of open area where people can sit and have a cup of coffee, and we'd like to have an exhibition of our products and services there as well, so that'll need to be quite a big space
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还需要一个开放式区域，供参会人员就座、喝咖啡；同时，我们也希望在此区域展示我们的产品和服务，因此这个空间需要相当宽敞。

sentences.en: ANGELA: That's fine, there's a central atrium with all those facilities, and you can come before the conference starts if you want to set everything up
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 没问题，酒店中央有一个带所有这些设施的中庭，您也可以在会议开始前前来布置一切。

sentences.en: MAN: Great
sentences.zh: MAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: And I presume there's wifi?
sentences.zh: 我猜酒店提供无线网络吧？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Oh yes, that's free and available throughout the hotel
sentences.zh: ANGELA: 哦，是的，全酒店范围内均免费提供Wi-Fi。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: ANGELA
sentences.zh: ANGELA。

sentences.en: Would you also like us to provide a buffet lunch?
sentences.zh: 您是否还需要我们提供自助午餐？

sentences.en: We can do a two-course meal with a number of different options
sentences.zh: 我们可以提供两道菜的套餐，有多种不同的选择。

sentences.en: MAN: What sort of price are we looking at for that?
sentences.zh: 男士：这个价位大概是多少？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Well, I can send you a copy of the standard menu
sentences.zh: 安吉拉：嗯，我可以给您发送一份标准菜单。

sentences.en: That's $45 per person
sentences.zh: 每人45美元。

sentences.en: Or you can have the special for $25 more
sentences.zh: 或者您也可以选择特别套餐，额外加25美元。

sentences.en: MAN: think the standard should be OK, but yes, send me the menu
sentences.zh: 男士：我觉得标准套餐应该就可以了，不过还是请把菜单发给我。

sentences.en: MAN
sentences.zh: 男士。

sentences.en: Now we're also going to need accommodation on the Saturday night for some of the participants I'm not sure how many, but probably about 25
sentences.zh: 另外，我们还需要为部分参会者预订周六晚上的住宿，具体人数还不确定，但大概有25人左右。

sentences.en: So what do you charge for a room?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们每间房的收费是多少？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Well, for conference attendees we have a 25% reduction, so we can offer you rooms at $135
sentences.zh: 安吉拉：嗯，针对会议参会者，我们提供25%的折扣，因此可以为您提供每间135美元的房间。

sentences.en: Normally a standard room's $180
sentences.zh: 通常标准间是180美元。

sentences.en: MAN: And does that include breakfast?
sentences.zh: 男士：这包含早餐吗？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Sure
sentences.zh: 安吉拉：当然包含。

sentences.en: And of course, guests can also make use of all the other facilities at the hotel
sentences.zh: 当然，客人还可以使用酒店的所有其他设施。

sentences.en: So we've got a spa where you can get massages and facials and so on, and there's a pool up on the roof for the use of guests
sentences.zh: 比如我们有一家水疗中心，可提供按摩、面部护理等服务；酒店顶层还设有一座供客人使用的游泳池。

sentences.en: MAN: Great
sentences.zh: 男士：太好了。

sentences.en: Now what about transport links?
sentences.zh: 那么交通方面呢？

sentences.en: The hotel's downtown, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 酒店位于市中心，对吧？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Yes, it's about 12 kilometres from the airport, but there's a complimentary shuttle bus for guests
sentences.zh: 安吉拉：是的，酒店距离机场约12公里，但我们会为客人提供免费的穿梭巴士服务。

sentences.en: And it's only about ten minutes' walk from the central railway station
sentences.zh: 而且，酒店距离中央火车站步行仅需约十分钟。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: 男士：好的。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know Sydney very well, can you just give me an idea of the location of the hotel?
sentences.zh: 我对悉尼不太熟悉，您能简单介绍一下酒店的位置吗？

sentences.en: ANGELA: Well. it's downtown on Wilby a Street, that's quite a small street, and it's not very far from the sea
sentences.zh: 安吉拉：嗯，酒店位于市中心威尔比街，那是一条比较小的街道，离海边也不远。

sentences.en: And of course if the conference attendees want to go out on the Saturday evening there's a huge choice of places to eat
sentences.zh: 当然，如果参会者想在周六晚上外出就餐，周边有大量餐厅可供选择。

sentences.en: Then if they want to make a night of it, they can go on to one of the clubs in the area - there are a great many to choose from
sentences.zh: 如果他们想彻夜狂欢，还可以前往附近区域的各类俱乐部——那里可供选择的俱乐部非常多。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: 男士：好的。

sentences.en: So if we go ahead with this, can you give me some information about how much
sentences.zh: 那么，如果我们最终确定采用这个方案，您能告诉我相关费用……
